AbstainedRow.description: NOT RANKED is a first-class row (I4): a reason and an instruction, no score, no rank.
AbstainedRow.title: AbstainedRow

Acvpu.description: NEWS2 level of consciousness: Alert, new Confusion, Voice, Pain, Unresponsive.
Acvpu.title: Acvpu

BloodPressure.description: Structured on purpose: the "SBP/DBP" string is display only and is never parsed.
BloodPressure.title: BloodPressure

LabPanel.description: Units follow Philippine hospital convention. null = no result; never zero (I1).
LabPanel.title: LabPanel

MeasurementAbsent.description: A value that is not there, with the reason. Never a zero, never a default (I1).
MeasurementAbsent.title: MeasurementAbsent

NewNote.description: The body of POST /patients/{id}/notes. The server assigns id, time and the flag.
NewNote.title: NewNote

NurseVitalsInput.description:
Nurse-entered NEWS2 inputs (POST /patients/{id}/vitals): any subset, at least one.

Blood pressure is a pair. Omitted means not entered (the stored value is left alone);
there is no default and nothing is clamped: an impossible value is rejected. Device-sourced
values (heart rate, respiratory rate, SpO2, temperature) are not accepted here. A stored
value carries source `nurse`, a manual clinician entry; the audit row for the write
records the clinician's id and role.
NurseVitalsInput.title: NurseVitalsInput

PartialAdmitPatientInput.description: AdmitPatientInput with every field optional (extraction results).
PartialAdmitPatientInput.title: PartialAdmitPatientInput

PartialLabInput.description: Nurse- or OCR-entered lab values. Omitted = not entered; there is no default value.
PartialLabInput.title: PartialLabInput

PatientSummary.description: One line of the patient picker (GET /patients): scoped to the caller.
PatientSummary.title: PatientSummary

Provenance.description: Where a value came from. Every key is required; null is allowed only where stated.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ProvenanceSource.description:
Where a value came from.

`nurse` means a manual clinician entry: a person typed it, whatever their role. Who entered
it is not on the measurement; the audit log holds the clinician id and role for the write
(an `entered_by` field is a backlog item).
ProvenanceSource.title: ProvenanceSource

ScoreRow.description:
A ranked patient: carries a NEWS2 score and rank. That every required input was
present is enforced by the scorer and arbiter (CP4/5), not by this schema (I1, I4).
ScoreRow.title: ScoreRow

Spo2Scale.description: RCP NEWS2 SpO2 scoring scale. Scale 2 is clinician-assigned (hypercapnic failure).
Spo2Scale.title: Spo2Scale

TierBFinding.description: A named observation with its own units. Not comparable on a shared scale.
TierBFinding.title: TierBFinding

TierCInput.description: Everything Tier C may read. Features in, never verdicts (OVERVIEW: fuse inputs).
TierCInput.title: TierCInput

UnscoredPatient.description:
Everything known about a patient before any score exists.

This is the state behind both a ranked row and a NOT RANKED row: scores, ranks and
reasons are computed from it on read (never stored), so a recorded value re-ranks the
patient. `signal_quality` and `last_update_s` are null for a patient with no patch.
UnscoredPatient.title: UnscoredPatient

VitalHistory.description: One 15-minute bin of a vital. `value` is null for a gap: never zero, never filled (I1).
VitalHistory.title: VitalHistory

VitalTrends.description: Sparkline series, oldest first, one entry per 15-minute bin. null = gap (I1).
VitalTrends.title: VitalTrends

VitalsRecorded.description: What was stored (the echo, with provenance) and where the patient stands now.
VitalsRecorded.title: VitalsRecorded
